title: Kostis's Particle Effects
description: Procedural particles for your maps, generated by math on the GPU: swirling orbs, sparks, motes, flames, crystals, rune circles, portals, shields and auras. Particles and orbs are real tokens with live animated looks; emitters stream sparks, embers, dust and trails that follow tokens exactly; effects spawn, fly (with Kostis's Actual Animator), trail, burst and clean up in one click. Part of Kostis's Flying Paths.

requires.reason: The Kostis's Flying Paths hub provides the launcher, map tools, GM relay and asset storage.

recommends.reason: Effects fly their particles along animator templates (homing missiles, orbiting orbs, lobbed fireballs…), and effect walls are drawn along animator paths.
